def kalman_filter(F, Q, H, R, zs, x0, P0):
    T = zs.shape[0]
    xs = np.zeros((T, x0.shape[0]))
    Ps = np.zeros((T, x0.shape[0], x0.shape[0]))
    x = x0.copy(); P = P0.copy()
    I = np.eye(P.shape[0])
    for t in range(T):
        # Predict
        x = F @ x
        P = F @ P @ F.T + Q
        # Update
        z = zs[t]
        y = z - H @ x
        S = H @ P @ H.T + R
        K = P @ H.T @ np.linalg.inv(S)
        x = x + K @ y
        P = (I - K @ H) @ P
        # Symmetrize for numerical stability
        P = 0.5*(P + P.T)
        xs[t] = x; Ps[t] = P
    return xs, Ps
